---
title: "Bdev reference dataset report"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  bundle_dir: "/bundle"
  output_dir: "/repo/figure_outputs/bdev_reference_report"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "100%",
  dpi = 180
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(scworkbench)
  library(ggplot2)
})

bundle_dir <- normalizePath(params$bundle_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
output_dir <- params$output_dir
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

bundle <- wb_open_bundle(bundle_dir, read_only = TRUE, validate = FALSE)

bundle_manifest <- wb_manifest(bundle)
source_inputs <- wb_prov_source_inputs(bundle)
source_rows <- source_inputs[source_inputs$source_id == "bdev_rdata", , drop = FALSE]
source_sha256 <- unique(as.character(source_rows$checksum_value))
source_paths <- unique(as.character(source_rows$path))
stopifnot(length(source_sha256) == 1L, nzchar(source_sha256))
all_cells <- as.character(wb_cells(bundle, cell_set = "all"))
sample_field <- "orig.ident"
default_umap <- "umap.atac"
reference_cell_set <- "set:bdev_reference"

sample_metadata <- wb_meta(
  bundle,
  cells = all_cells,
  cols = list(wb_ref_metadata_field("core:cell_id"), sample_field)
)
stopifnot(
  identical(as.character(sample_metadata$cell_id), all_cells),
  !anyNA(sample_metadata[[sample_field]])
)

sample_values <- factor(
  as.character(sample_metadata[[sample_field]]),
  levels = sort(unique(as.character(sample_metadata[[sample_field]])))
)
names(sample_values) <- all_cells

sample_counts <- as.data.frame(table(sample_id = sample_values), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(sample_counts)[2L] <- "cells"
sample_counts$percent <- round(100 * sample_counts$cells / sum(sample_counts$cells), 1)

space_registry <- wb_space_info(bundle)
umap_record <- space_registry[space_registry$space_id == default_umap, , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(nrow(umap_record) == 1L, as.integer(umap_record$dims[[1L]]) == 2L)

umap_coordinates <- wb_space(bundle, default_umap, cells = all_cells)
if (is.data.frame(umap_coordinates)) {
  stopifnot(identical(as.character(umap_coordinates$cell_id), all_cells))
  coordinate_values <- as.matrix(umap_coordinates[, c("x", "y"), drop = FALSE])
} else {
  stopifnot(identical(rownames(umap_coordinates), all_cells))
  coordinate_values <- as.matrix(umap_coordinates)
}
stopifnot(ncol(coordinate_values) == 2L, all(is.finite(coordinate_values)))

vector_artifacts <- wb_art_list(bundle, type = "cell_vector")
pseudotime_rows <- vector_artifacts[
  vector_artifacts$source_op == "metadata_cell_vector" &
    grepl("bdev_reference_pseudotime", vector_artifacts$name, fixed = TRUE),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
stopifnot(nrow(pseudotime_rows) == 1L)
pseudotime_artifact_id <- as.character(pseudotime_rows$artifact_id[[1L]])
pseudotime <- wb_read_cell_vector(
  bundle,
  paste0("artifact:", pseudotime_artifact_id),
  all_cells
)
stopifnot(
  identical(names(pseudotime), all_cells),
  all(is.finite(pseudotime[!is.na(pseudotime)]))
)

n_pseudotime <- sum(!is.na(pseudotime))
n_not_in_trajectory <- sum(is.na(pseudotime))

matrix_registry <- wb_matrices(bundle)
matrix_ids <- as.character(matrix_registry$matrix_id)
rownames(matrix_registry) <- NULL

plot_theme <- theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10.5, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 8.5, colour = "grey35", hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
  )

sample_plot <- wb_plot_space_2d(
  bundle = bundle,
  space_id = default_umap,
  cell_set = "all",
  overlay_sets = reference_cell_set,
  color_by = sample_values,
  color_label = "Sample ID",
  overlay_alpha = 0.75,
  overlay_size = 0.35,
  label_groups = TRUE,
  label_by = sample_values,
  label_min_n = 1L,
  continuous_na_color = "grey85"
) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", na.value = "grey85") +
  labs(
    title = "Bdev reference cells by sample",
    subtitle = "Peaks assay UMAP (umap.atac); Sample ID is source metadata field orig.ident",
    caption = paste0("Cells: ", format(length(all_cells), big.mark = ","))
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  plot_theme

trajectory_plot <- wb_plot_space_2d(
  bundle = bundle,
  space_id = default_umap,
  cell_set = "all",
  overlay_sets = reference_cell_set,
  color_by = pseudotime,
  color_label = "Pseudotime (pt)",
  overlay_alpha = 0.82,
  overlay_size = 0.35,
  continuous_palette = "turbo",
  continuous_na_color = "grey85"
) +
  labs(
    title = "Bdev reference trajectory",
    subtitle = "Rainbow coded by the promoted pt pseudotime; cells without pseudotime are light grey",
    caption = paste0(
      "Promoted artifact: ", pseudotime_artifact_id,
      " | Included: ", format(n_pseudotime, big.mark = ","),
      " | Not included: ", format(n_not_in_trajectory, big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  plot_theme

sample_png <- file.path(output_dir, "bdev_reference_umap_sample_id.png")
trajectory_png <- file.path(output_dir, "bdev_reference_umap_trajectory.png")
ggsave(sample_png, sample_plot, width = 8.2, height = 6.8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(trajectory_png, trajectory_plot, width = 8.2, height = 6.8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
wb_close_bundle(bundle)
```

## Dataset overview

This report describes the promoted **`r bundle_manifest$bundle_name`** scWorkbench
bundle. It contains **`r format(length(all_cells), big.mark = ",")` cells** from
four source samples. All UMAP panels use **`r default_umap`**, the imported
two-dimensional embedding recorded for the **peaks assay**.

The reference trajectory uses the previously promoted cell-vector artifact
`r pseudotime_artifact_id`, derived from the source metadata field `pt`. It has
defined pseudotime for **`r format(n_pseudotime, big.mark = ",")` cells
(`r round(100 * n_pseudotime / length(all_cells), 1)`%)**. The remaining
**`r format(n_not_in_trajectory, big.mark = ",")` cells** retain missing
pseudotime and appear in light grey.

```{r overview-table}
overview <- data.frame(
  item = c(
    "Bundle ID", "Source SHA-256", "Cells", "Samples", "Matrices", "Coordinate spaces",
    "Default UMAP", "Cells with pseudotime", "Cells without pseudotime"
  ),
  value = c(
    bundle_manifest$bundle_id,
    source_sha256,
    format(length(all_cells), big.mark = ","),
    nrow(sample_counts),
    length(matrix_ids),
    nrow(space_registry),
    default_umap,
    format(n_pseudotime, big.mark = ","),
    format(n_not_in_trajectory, big.mark = ",")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(overview, col.names = c("Item", "Value"), align = c("l", "l"))
```

The bundle provenance identifies the source as
`r paste(source_paths, collapse = ", ")` with SHA-256 `r source_sha256`.

  c("matrix_id", "layer", "feature_type", "n_features", "n_cells", "storage"),

)
knitr::kable(matrix_registry[, matrix_columns, drop = FALSE])

```{r space-table}

knitr::kable(space_registry[, space_columns, drop = FALSE])
```

## Validation and methods

The bundle was opened read-only. Public scWorkbench getters confirmed that all
26,723 requested cells occur in `umap.atac` in bundle order, that every UMAP
coordinate is finite, that Sample ID has no missing values, and that the
promoted pseudotime vector returns values in the same cell order. No bundle
state was changed and no new artifact was promoted.

Plots were generated with `scworkbench::wb_plot_space_2d()`. Sample ID uses the
source metadata field `orig.ident`. Trajectory color uses the existing promoted
`metadata_cell_vector` artifact; its missing values were retained and rendered
as light grey. The continuous `turbo` palette supplies the requested rainbow
color progression.

Report generated `r format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")` with
scWorkbench `r as.character(packageVersion("scworkbench"))` and R
`r paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")`.
